_comment: Defaults for the accommodation add-on. A site overrides any key in its app-custom-config.json.

accommodation-read.description: See accommodations, their owners and occupants, and assessments
accommodation-read.label: See accommodations

accommodation-units-list.description: See the list of accommodations by street address, with no names: the unit choices on the Occupancy information form
accommodation-units-list.label: See the list of unit addresses

accommodation-manage.description: Manage the accommodation add-on: accommodations, owners and the directory import
accommodation-manage.label: Manage accommodations

owner.name: owner
owner.description: Owns an accommodation. Given and taken away by the accommodation add-on from the dated ownership entries

occupant.name: occupant
occupant.description: Lives in an accommodation. Given and taken away by the accommodation add-on from the dated occupancy entries

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Accommodation administration
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Admins see and manage accommodations. A site grants accommodation-read or accommodation-manage to its board or treasurer in its own policy.

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Accommodation: the list of unit addresses
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Every visitor and every user may see the units by street address, to pick their unit on a form. Addresses only, never names.
